descriptionHtml:
Premium 10'×20' Custom Canopy Tent

Elevate your event setup with our Premium 10'×20' Custom Canopy Tent, engineered for professional vendors who need maximum space, durability, and high-impact branding. This oversized canopy features a 40mm heavy-duty aluminum frame, fully custom 600D dye-sublimation canopy, and includes a single-sided full back wall for superior privacy and visual impact.
Comes complete with a wheeled carry bag and free nationwide FedEx ground shipping.

Key Features

🛡️ Durable 600D Polyester Canopy: Weather-resistant fabric designed for long-term outdoor use.

🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation: Your artwork is printed in high resolution on a white canopy for vibrant, fade-resistant results.

💪 Heavy-Duty Frame: Built with 1.2 mm anodized aluminum for superior strength.

🔩 Reinforced Hardware: Frame equipped with ABS glass-filled nylon joints for added durability.

📏 HEX Legs for Stability: Hexagon-shaped legs measuring 1.75" provide maximum support.

⬆️ Pinch-Free Height Adjustment: Plastic levers allow smooth and safe height changes.

🧱 Full Back Wall (Single-Sided): Included for enhanced branding, shade, privacy, and weather protection.

🧳 Portable & Convenient: Easily collapses to fit into the included wheeled soft carry bag.

🪢 Secure Setup: Includes rope and peg kit; proper anchoring is required to maintain warranty.

🖨️ Imprint Method: High-quality Full-Color Dye Sublimation.

Product Dimensions

📐 Product Size: 120" W × 137" H × 240" D
📦 Collapsible Size: 9.12" W × 62.75" H × 9.12" D
🎒 Case Dimensions: 12.5" W × 56.25" H × 15.5" D
⚖️ Product Weight: 40 lbs

Kit Includes

🧩 1× Aluminum Frame
🎪 1× Custom Printed Canopy
🧱 1× Full Back Wall (Single-Sided)
🧳 1× Wheeled Carry Bag
🪢 1× Ropes & Pegs Set

Optional Accessories

6' Table Cover
Feather Flags
Sandbags

Materials

🔧 Hardware: ABS Nylon, Aluminum
🧵 Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications

🔥 Meets FR Rating Requirements

Primary Usage

Outdoor events, trade shows, food booths, festivals, markets, brand activations, and vendor setups.

Factory Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
